program: SYM-01 — Primary Symbol / App-Icon Successor Divergence
question: Can a structurally non-Threshold-K monochrome symbol challenge the incumbent across compact app-icon/chrome and expressive web identity roles while preserving Kymaean's human/relational identity laws without relying on color, wordmark, material, motion, imagery, or product-semantic iconography?

incumbent_control.name: Threshold K
incumbent_control.law: Use exact existing testing-adapter bytes. The original historical raster remains visual source authority. No geometry edit is allowed in SYM-01.

generic_control.construction: simple interrupted ring with centered witness dot
generic_control.purpose: generic modern-app-symbol calibration only; ineligible for promotion

challenger_families.name: Split Field
challenger_families.topology: two complementary unequal masses separated by one nonlinear seam inside a shared compact envelope

challenger_families.name: Continuous Fold
challenger_families.topology: one continuous open band with two major changes of direction and no arrowhead or closed loop

challenger_families.name: Counterweighted Pair
challenger_families.topology: two unequal self-contained masses in a non-mirrored near-relation with no shared enclosing frame

challenger_families.name: Offset Aperture
challenger_families.topology: one dominant field with one non-letter interior counterform and one edge interruption that changes silhouette

family_separation_law: No challenger may use three surrounding fields or an emergent K-shaped counterform.
No challenger may be a one-parameter mutation of another challenger or Threshold K.
Primary topology, component count, enclosure logic, and negative-space role must differ materially among F1-F4.
neutralization: single currentColor only; no gradients, texture, blur, glow, shadow, depth, material or color identity
no KYMÆAN wordmark, letters, monograms or bespoke typography in scored symbols
no arrows, play buttons, sparkle/stars, network nodes, chat bubbles, eyes, portals/doors, people, chain links, infinity signs or semantic software glyphs
no motion or state treatment; STA/MOT packets are absent from the carrier
no product labels or claims inside the scored mark

test_matrix.rule: Geometry is identical across context, size and mode; only scale/currentColor/container framing may change.

mechanical_floors: self-contained SVG with deterministic viewBox and no external resources
no text element in the scored symbol SVG
no horizontal/vertical clipping in any matrix cell
visible geometry remains inside the icon safe envelope at every size
forced-colors rendering retains the same topology and component relationships
compact app fixture does not require the surrounding container to complete the symbol
C0 bytes remain unchanged from repository authority
subjective_falsification: FAIL if the symbol reads primarily as a familiar software/category glyph or literal semantic icon.
FAIL if small-scale recognition depends on decorative detail lost below 24 px.
FAIL if the symbol needs color/material/wordmark to feel authored.
FAIL if it becomes a disguised Threshold K descendant rather than a successor challenger.
FAIL if its strongest reading is an unintended eye, person, doorway, play/control, chain/link, leaf/wellness, AI sparkle/network, infinity, search/Q, or other category convention.
FAIL if app and web require different geometry rather than scale/hierarchy adaptation.
PASS does not mean final logo selection; it means the challenger survives for direct incumbent comparison.
review_order: 5. direct survivor comparison against exact Threshold K C0
6. freeze Design Sol view before Director preference

termination.director_gate: If one or more challengers survive direct C0 comparison, present the exact frozen board and Design Sol view for consequential Director taste/convergence input.

explicit_non_authority: No final symbol, app icon, production vector, Store/package asset, trademark clearance, runtime Windows rendering, final identity or Phase-C convergence.
No CLR-01 family selection or retune; no O3/TYP/MOT/STA/material/hero change.
